**Container tests fail** In the development container, `REPO_ROOT` becomes `/app`, but `docker-compose.yml` does not mount `env.template` and `Dockerfile` never copies it. The new test therefore raises `FileNotFoundError` when it reads `/app/env.template`. Make the template available in that container so developers can run the backend tests there.

Make the template available in that container so developers can run the backend tests there. --- For each issue above, determine whether it is valid and should be fixed. If so, fix it directly. `````

**Patch limit sounds server-wide** `ROM_PATCHER_MAX_CONCURRENCY` limits patches per API worker, not across the server. Each process creates its own `_patch_semaphore`, so the default four API workers can run eight patches at once when this value is `2`. Say “per API worker” so users sizing memory do not mistake this for a server-wide limit. ```suggestion ROM_PATCHER_MAX_CONCURRENCY=2 # How many ROM patches can run at once per API worker (minimum 1) ``` **Knowledge Base Used:** [Backend runtime and operations](https://app.greptile.com/romm/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/rommapp/romm/-/docs/backend-runtime-and-operations.md)
